_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/subscription.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: One row per user: the plan and the free-tier counters. Billing source of truth. The backend writes with the service key; a user can only read their own row.
rules: plan is free or paid (database check).
paystack_subscription_code and current_period_end exist but the backend never writes them; updated_at has no trigger.
